definitions.explanation: Describes an appliance or device that performs only one function, in contrast to a multifunctional model. Commonly used for kitchen appliances — a microwave that only heats, a printer that only prints, etc. Frequently used as a noun modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {単機能|たんきのう}の{電子|でんし}レンジを{買|か}った。
{単機能|たんきのう}{家電|かでん}は{操作|そうさ}が{簡単|かんたん}だ。
examples.english: Single-function appliances are easy to operate.

examples.japanese: {多機能|たきのう}{機種|きしゅ}は{高|たか}いので、{予算|よさん}を{抑|おさ}えたい{人|ひと}には{単機能|たんきのう}タイプがおすすめだ。
examples.english: Multifunctional models are expensive, so for those looking to keep costs down, a single-function type is recommended.

notes:
Compound of {単|たん} (single) + {機能|きのう} (function). The direct antonym is {多機能|たきのう} (multifunctional), and the two are routinely contrasted in product descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単機能|たんきのう}{電子|でんし}レンジ: single-function microwave (heating only)
- {単機能|たんきのう}タイプ: single-function type
- {単機能|たんきのう}{家電|かでん}: single-function home appliance
- {単機能|たんきのう}モデル: basic / single-function model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多機能|たきのう}: multifunctional (antonym)
- シンプル: simple — overlaps in nuance but is broader
- ベーシック: basic — a marketing-flavored loanword used the same way
